svg.aria-label: DynamoDB Spring Boot coroutine repository components
svg.text: Spring Boot wires the async clients and table resolver; application repositories own keys, schemas, and table lifecycle.

g.text: Application repositories own entity mapping, keys, and table naming decisions.
DAX changes the backing async client, not the repository API surface.

svg.text: Auto-configuration supplies clients and naming; migrations or tests still create the DynamoDB tables.
